name: Emma
source:
A philosophy student and photographer, Emma sees the beauty in everything.

When she has a model in her lens, the need to capture the perfect image takes over. Nothing else matters, but that one stolen slice of time.

A true connoisseur of beauty, Emma will stop at nothing to capture the perfect picture of the perfect subject.

[From [url=https://dumbkoala.art/MeetTheCast/info.php?name=Emma]DumbKoala[/url]]
